messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered — tokenstore write queue depth elevated in eu-west1 (INC-2026-179). p95 write latency 2.1s -> 4.3s, p99 5.9s -> 9.1s. Pager sent to primary oncall. Root thread starting at 1808887776
anya: picking this up — I'm primary for tonight. quick summary: tokenstore client retries are backing up; writes to tokenstore DB showing increased 5xx and retry storms. Some backpressure to the request queue is visible; regen traffic and embeddings customers most likely to see 500/timeout.
mike: annotated that we're seeing a correlated spike in redis conn wait and db retry counters. any easy kill-switches?
anya: work in progress. current mitigations in flight: 1) rate-limit noisy clients via routing rules 2) increase tokenstore write workers in eu-west staging pool (can scale to +2 nodes) 3) enable fallback model-variant for high-latency paths 4) temporary route traffic to eu-central warm pool for critical customers.
kevin: pinging infra to confirm scaling. i've queued a scale op, ETA ~3m. infra ticket: #infra-4289.
anya: notes / commands i've run so far: ```
# check tokenstore retry histogram
kubectl -n platform exec svc/tokenstore-metrics -- curl -s http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep tokenstore_retry
# scale write workers
kubectl -n inference scale deployment tokenstore-writer-eu-west --replicas=6
# apply routing quick patch (rate limit noisy client)
redwoodctl routes apply --selector client:regen-noisy --rate-limit 20rps
```
anya: observed immediate drop in retry rate after rate-limit patch. p95 dropped to ~3.1s, p99 still high (~6.8s). scaling coming up.
mike: any customers impacted that we should notify?
anya: early list (based on request logs): - several mid-market SaaS customers using embeddings endpoint - 2 enterprise accounts with heavy regen loops (IDs redacted) - internal QA harness showing elevated failures. Impact level: degraded for a small subset of traffic, not full outage.
oliver: added a temporary traffic mirror to eu-central for a subset of high-priority customers so we can validate fallback behavior. mirror rule id: mirror-3312.
kevin: infra completed scale at 1808887860 — tokenstore writer pods are up (+2). confirm load?
anya: confirming now — traffic spreading across new writer pods. CPU on writers at 55% now, queue depth trending down but still above baseline. p99 trending down to 5.0s.
oncall-lead-bot: Reminder: update runbook run status in Incident Manager, set priority to P2 if not already, and set customer comms owner.
anya: done — Incident Manager updated (INC-2026-179). assigning customer-comms to mike. I'm leaving sticky notes for next shift: see runbook snippet and playbook links below.
mike: i'll draft a short comms note for affected customers after we confirm stabilization. will post draft here.
anya: runbook links / useful dashboards: - Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tokenstore-backpressure - Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/rtq/tokenstore-eu-west - Logs (KL): https://logs.redwood/q/tokenstore/eu-west?from=now-2h
anya: quick playbook excerpt to follow in case we need to escalate: 1) throttle noisy clients via route tag 2) warmstart secondary pool (eu-central) 3) roll back recent tokenstore client release (if spike coincided with deploy) 4) contact DB vendor if persistent 5) open customer-impact thread in #support-ops
kevin: i'm also pushing a temporary config to reduce client retry backoff (shorten retry window) so we don't create a retry stampede. patch id cfg-998.
mike: draft comms (pls review): "We're investigating elevated latency for token storage writes in eu-west1 impacting embeddings and regenerate flows. We've applied mitigations (client rate-limiting, additional worker capacity) and are seeing improvement; will follow up with timeline and root cause. If you're seeing errors, reply to this thread or contact support."
anya: looks good — add "workarounds: prefer eu-central for heavy batch jobs" and note ETA for final update (~1h).
mike: updated draft and posted to #support-ops as incident bulletin.
kevin: FYI — no recent deploys to tokenstore in last 2h per deploy-log. suspect load pattern from customer regen loops.
anya: next steps for whoever takes over (handoff checklist): - watch p95/p99 and queue depth - verify mirror groups in eu-central for subset - confirm no deploys in tokenstore client - validate throttled clients show reduced retries - prepare customer com update once p99 < 3.0s for 15m - escalate to DB vendor if elevated after 45m
oliver: leaving runbook markers in the runbook doc with timestamps and commands executed.
anya: i'm handing off in 20m. primary will switch to mike at timestamp 1808887996. secondary: kevin. if anything pages, escalate to eng-sre oncall.
mike: ack. i'll be primary from 1808887996 — will keep updates here and notify if any regressions. thanks Anya. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: System note: scheduled handoff window recorded for INC-2026-179.
mike: quick check 10m after scale — p99 down to 3.8s, queue depth down 42%. continuing to watch.
anya: handing over private checkpoint logs for follow-up RCA: https://internal.redwood/rca/INC-2026-179/checkpoints (internal-only). leaving a small follow-up ticket to investigate retry backoff logic: #eng-ml-1210.
mike: tagging kevin for infra follow-up on retry window config. kevin?
kevin: saw the tag, will follow up. will keep this channel updated if anything else shifts.
mike: last note before sleep — if p99 creeps back above 5s, rollback throttling patch and revert to warm pool routing, then escalate.
anya: thanks all — handing off bridge now.
mike: bridge active. taking primary.
anya: :wave:
